shards.name: Ultima Online (official, EA/OSI)
shards.notes: Official servers, the first login server of the official Login.cfg (the client tries IP addresses, not the name: login.ultimaonline.com did not resolve through a SOCKS5 proxy). Same login on 75.2.70.184:7776, 13.248.219.129:7775 and :7776. The client version must be the official client's exact build; the session also sends what the official client sends on its own (time sync, assistant version, world-entry packets).
